responsibility: Implements generic tree-operand walking over GIMPLE statements and sequences. It provides traversal of statements, substatements, operands, asm constraints, loads, stores, and address operands with callback hooks, supports sequence walking with modification, and supplies utility walkers used primarily before SSA form or by analyses that need structured operand visitation outside the SSA operand iterators.
same_name_distinction: Implementation of the generic GIMPLE/tree walking routines, including statement, sequence, operand, and load/store/address visitors; gcc/gimple-walk.h only defines the callback types, walk_stmt_info state, and function prototypes for that walker API.
